title: Continuous ringed-topos construction with specified adjoint transpose
statement: Let $(C,J)$ and $(D,K)$ be sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] whose categories are essentially small in the coefficient universe. Let $F:D\to C$ be continuous, let $L:\operatorname{Sh}(D,K)\to\operatorname{Sh}(C,J)$ be a finite-limit-preserving left adjoint to precomposition by $F$, and let $R,S$ be commutative-ring sheaves on $C,D$. Given $\phi:S\to F_*R$, define a morphism of ringed topoi [def-pur-ringed-topos-morphism-of-universes] with inverse image $L$, direct image $F_*$, and structural map the inverse adjoint transpose of the underlying set map of $\phi$. Its module direct image is sectionwise precomposition with scalars restricted along $\phi$. The ring identities and module-linearity identities are proved from naturality of the adjunction with respect to the sectionwise operations.
